package.name: moveit2_extended_mujoco
package.description:
MuJoCo behind ros2_control.
The simulator is exposed as a hardware_interface::SystemInterface rather than as a bespoke node that replays trajectories. That is the difference between testing the robot and testing the test: with this, joint_trajectory_controller drives the simulated arm, MoveIt executes FollowJointTrajectory into it exactly as it would on hardware, and the same Objective XML runs in both places. It also needs no GPU, so it can run while one is busy with something else.
urdf_to_mujoco.py converts a ROS URDF into a model MuJoCo will load, adding the position actuators and named keyframes that a URDF has no way to express.
